name: Rugat (Spain)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with a yellow castle between four white croziers in saltire, two on each side.
history: The official flag of Rugat is of proportions 2:3, azure, a castle or at the centre flanked by four croziers argent in saltire, two by two; it was approved by resolution of 18 January 2005 of the Conseller of Justice and Public Administrations and published in the DOGV. The arms had been approved by resolution of 8 March 2004.

features.role: four croziers in saltire, two on each side of the castle
